description: One system that combines every layer of the track: retrieval, tools over MCP, a budgeted agent with a verifier inside a permission policy, evals, a threat model and a governance map.

term: Simplest design that meets the evals
description: The capstone's first criterion: workflow before agent, one agent before several, retrieval before adaptation. Each component must buy a measured improvement.
Making an attack impossible by architecture: here, the policy denies every `send_*` tool, so injected instructions have no exfiltration channel.
Anything the policy does not explicitly allow is denied: unknown tools, malformed arguments and unapproved actions never reach the server.
A release check over the golden set: the pass rate must reach the threshold and no critical case may fail.
Owners, data classification and approval per tool, the pinned model, budgets, the eval gate and the review cadence, checked against the running code.
